params.note2: 18 October (Ben): T1B/T4 courtyard is landside; T2 as long as T3 (west end to E 702,000); T3 reshaped to a plain bar (west wing removed); T1A stem extended south into the parking area to N 4,325,050; T1B/T4 back in place (no shift)
params.note3: 18 October (Ben): T1B/T4 back in place (landside and grounds from CVG Landside.kmz / CVG Grounds.kmz); tunnel notches on T1A and T1B aligned on the CVX line and made small; T1B carried north to N 4,326,880; T4 small widebodies (787-8 / 767-200); T2 49 m and T3 22 m south
params.note4: Realistic stand model (research 18 Oct): nose 11.3 m (37 ft) off the facade, 1.5 m tail clearance + 7.6 m tail-of-stand road, dual taxilanes between facing rows (PANYNJ: no single taxilane for more than 8 contact gates); taxilane CL to object FAA 13A (ADG VI 51 m, V 42 m), CL to CL ICAO (87.5 / 72.5 m)
params.note5: 18 October (Ben): Pan Am to 60 stands by shortening the T1A stem; Delta 2:1 smaller (A330/767/787) to large (747/777/A350); 797 stands added. Pan Am mix from the canon fleet (777-8 70, 747-10 15, A350 7 = 92 L; 787-9 75, 787-10 18 = 93 S; 797-6 20, 797-7 51 = 71 D; midpoints). Delta: L 1/3, S 1/3, D 1/3. T3 unchanged (L 0.4).
params.note6: 18 October (Ben): 797 is 767-200 sized. Parking: a 797 may use any stand; smaller widebodies (787, A330, 767-300) may use large stands; 747s large stands only.
params.note7: 18 October (Ben): four stand sizes. A380 (5: 3 Pan Am, 2 Gateway partners), large (747-size), widebody (787-size, widened to 64.8 m span), small (797-size, sized for the 767-300ER with winglets). 787-8 class folded into the 787-size stand; T4 two-thirds small, one-third 787-size. Parking: a smaller aircraft may use any larger stand.
